en.headline: HKEX launches first offshore RMB bond index to track dim sum bonds
en.dek: The exchange said the new benchmark, administered with Bloomberg, covers hundreds of bonds and supports future ETFs as Hong Kong builds its offshore yuan ecosystem.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing announced on Monday the launch of the HKEX Offshore RMB Bond Index, its first branded fixed-income index and the city’s first benchmark for dim sum bonds issued in Hong Kong.

The index tracks offshore renminbi-denominated Treasury, government-related and corporate bonds that are listed on the Stock Exchange or lodged with the Central Moneymarkets Unit and meet the methodology criteria. Bloomberg Index Services Limited will administer and calculate the index.

HKEX chief executive Bonnie Y Chan said the launch advances the fixed-income market from an issuance centre towards an ecosystem with greater depth and investability, supporting the internationalisation of the renminbi. Bloomberg’s Asia-Pacific chairman Bing Li noted the opportunity for Hong Kong as an offshore RMB hub.

As of 30 September, offshore RMB bond issuance this year had exceeded RMB 590 billion excluding certificates of deposit. Total bond issuance on HKEX is up 18.6 per cent year-to-date compared with last year’s full-year total, and Hong Kong has accounted for more than half of exchange-listed offshore RMB bonds globally since 2024. Several asset managers are preparing products based on the index family.

zh.headline: 港交所推出首個離岸人民幣債券指數 追蹤點心債
zh.dek: 港交所周一宣布推出與彭博合作編制的指數，作為香港點心債基準，支持日後ETF產品，推動離岸人民幣生態。
body: 香港交易所周一宣布推出「香港交易所離岸人民幣債券指數」，這是其首個冠名固定收益指數，亦是香港首個追蹤在港發行點心債的基準指數。
指數涵蓋在聯交所上市或存放於債務工具中央結算系統的離岸人民幣計價國債、政府相關及企業債券，並符合編制方法的納入準則。彭博指數服務有限公司負責管理及計算指數。
港交所行政總裁陳翊庭表示，指數有助固定收益市場由發行中心邁向更具深度、流動性及可投資性的生態圈，進一步推動人民幣國際化。彭博亞太區主席李冰指，離岸人民幣市場發展為香港提供機遇。
截至9月30日，今年離岸人民幣債券發行規模已超過5900億元人民幣（不包括存單）。港交所債券發行量按年至今上升18.6%，較去年全年總額為高；自2024年起，香港持續佔全球交易所上市離岸人民幣債券逾半。多間資產管理公司正籌備以指數為基礎的產品。
